newsitem.title: USA: Northwest to levy domestic fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Northwest to levy domestic fuel surcharge.

text.p: Northwest Airlines said it will begin charging a fuel surcharge on all U.S. domestic freight and express shipments, effective February 1.

The airline said the surcharge on general freight would be two cents a pound. For VIP Same Day Package Service, the surcharge is applied to each piece by weight break at $3 for 0-50 pounds, $4 for 51-70 pounds and $6 for 71-100 pounds.
Northwest said it was following similar pricing initiatives announced recently by UPS, FedEx and others that take effect in February.
The airline said it would review the fuel surcharge "as economic conditions change."
